Customer Service Representative, Credit Collection Officer Job at Comatrix Collection Service




        
    

        
        Comatrix Collection Service - We are a professional collection service provider that deals with helping various loan agencies in retrieving back their bad-loans as fast and effectively as possible.

We make calls to customers to pay their outstanding debts, Send messages to customers, Guide customers through the payment process, Persuade reluctant customers to make payment promptly, Meet weekly and monthly targets, Give proper and correct report of work.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Customer Service Representative, Credit Collection Officer

Job Location: Ijaiye, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Contact customers to follow-up on outstanding loan repayments.
	Negotiate and agree on feasible repayment plans.
	Maintain accurate records of all collection activities.


Requirements


	Minimum qualification: OND, NCE, HND and B.Sc.
	Previous experience in loan collection is an added advantage.
	Must own an Android phone.
	Good communication and negotiation skills.


Salary
N60,000 - N200,000 per month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Loan Collection officer" as the subject of the mail.

Note: For more information, Whatsapp 09078017395.
